sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 3x to 6x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Applies Miasma for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 25 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 25 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
